description: Owner (pemilik) dashboard + reports, admin user/staff management, final UI polish, documentation + env/DB-switch instructions, and read-only verification that the backend satisfies rubric BE1-BE5. Depends on FEAT-001..FEAT-004.
steps: Create frontend/src/app/(owner)/ guarded to roles ['pemilik','admin'] with layout/nav. Dashboard reads GET /api/reports/dashboard via useDashboard and renders StatCards: revenueToday, revenueMonth, activeTickets breakdown (Antre/Diperiksa/Dikerjakan), completedToday, and a low-stock list (lowStockParts).

Build the revenue report page reading GET /api/reports/revenue via useRevenue with a date-range filter (startDate/endDate YYYY-MM-DD); enforce client-side the both-or-neither and not-reversed rule from report.validation.ts before querying. Render totals (serviceTotal, partsTotal, revenue) and the per-day table (days[]), with an empty state for ranges with no transactions.
Build a low-stock overview reading GET /api/parts/low-stock (admin/pemilik) reusing the parts table with isLowStock highlighting.

Create admin-only staff/user management (guard role ['admin']): a create-staff form mirroring createStaffSchema (name, email, password min 6, role in admin|kasir|mekanik|pemilik, phone min 8); a paginated user list (GET /api/users) with role/isActive/search filters; and an activate/deactivate toggle (PATCH /api/users/:id/status) surfacing the backend's self-deactivation guard message.

Final polish pass across all areas for FE2/FE4: consistent responsive layout (mobile + desktop), loading skeletons, toast notifications, error states, hover effects, and consistent Indonesian domain labels (Antre/Diperiksa/etc.). Verify role-based nav shows only permitted links.

Write documentation: frontend/README.md (setup, pnpm commands, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL, role map, G6 notes) and a prominent SETUP section (root SETUP.md or a README addition) explaining the dummy-DB default and EXACTLY how to switch to a real Atlas string (mongodb+srv://user:pass@cluster.xxxx.mongodb.net/motorcenter_phase3), then cd backend && pnpm run seed && pnpm run dev. Keep backend/.env MONGODB_URI as the clearly-labeled placeholder and add/confirm a clear comment in backend/.env.example. Do NOT commit real credentials and do NOT change the app default to in-memory.

Verify the backend rubric points read-only: run cd backend && pnpm run typecheck and record evidence for BE1 (Express 4, app.ts/routes), BE2 (Mongoose 8 models), BE3 (CRUD across parts/services/users/bookings controllers), BE4 (bcryptjs salt-10 pre-save hook + password stripped in toJSON, user.model.ts), BE5 (authMiddleware Bearer JWT + authorizeRoles + per-resource scoping). Fix ONLY a genuine defect. If a real/in-memory DB is available for a local run, smoke-test GET /api/health; otherwise state clearly what could not be verified without a DB. Record all evidence in this feature's findings.
Confirm no secrets are committed: git check-ignore backend/.env frontend/.env.local must list both; .env.example files are tracked. Clean up any temporary files created during verification.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm run build and pnpm run lint pass for the frontend.
The owner dashboard renders all metrics from the API; the revenue report filters by date range with correct validation and shows per-day rows; low-stock overview lists flagged parts.
Admin can create staff, list/filter users, and toggle active status; the self-deactivation guard message surfaces.
cd backend && pnpm run typecheck passes and BE1-BE5 evidence is recorded in findings (with any DB-dependent gaps stated explicitly).
git check-ignore backend/.env frontend/.env.local lists both paths; backend/.env MONGODB_URI remains the placeholder; SETUP instructions for the real DB are present.
UI is responsive and consistent with loading/toast/error/hover states across roles (FE2/FE4).
verification: cd c:/Users/Acer/Documents/ANTIGRAV/bengkel-motor-6/frontend && pnpm run build && pnpm run lint
Manual (backend + seeded DB): as owner@motorcenter.id view dashboard and revenue report; as admin create a staff account and toggle a user. If no DB is available, record which steps were unverified.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED (frontend/src):
- Owner area at app/(owner)/ guarded to ['pemilik','admin'] with layout/nav. layout.tsx shows Dasbor, Laporan Omzet, Stok Menipis to both roles; Pengguna + Operasional (link to /staff) only when role==='admin'.
- owner/page.tsx: dashboard via useDashboard -> StatCards revenueToday, revenueMonth, completedToday, low-stock count; a 'Tiket Aktif' trio (Antre/Diperiksa/Dikerjakan from activeTickets); and a low-stock table (lowStockParts) with empty state.
- owner/revenue/page.tsx: useRevenue with startDate/endDate (YYYY-MM-DD) filter. Client-side validateRange() enforces both-or-neither and not-reversed BEFORE querying (mirrors backend report.validation.ts); shows inline error, does not send invalid range. Renders serviceTotal/partsTotal/revenue StatCards + per-day table (days[]) with empty state.
- owner/low-stock/page.tsx: GET /api/parts/low-stock via new useLowStockParts hook; reuses parts table shape with isLowStock highlighting.
- owner/users/page.tsx: admin-only (nested RoleGuard allowedRoles=['admin']). Create-staff dialog mirrors createStaffSchema (name>=2, email, password>=6, role enum admin|kasir|mekanik|pemilik, phone>=8). Paginated user list (GET /api/users) with role/isActive/search filters; activate/deactivate via ConfirmDialog -> PATCH /api/users/:id/status. The backend self-deactivation guard message is surfaced via the toast on the mutation error path (useToggleUserStatus uses the API error message).
- hooks/use-mutations.ts: added useCreateStaff, useToggleUserStatus (invalidate ['users']+['mechanics']).
- hooks/use-queries.ts: added useLowStockParts. (useDashboard/useRevenue/useUsers + services/users.ts, services/reports.ts already existed from earlier FEATs.)
- Zod v4 note: frontend uses zod ^4; z.enum custom message uses { message } (NOT errorMap, which is a v3 API and fails typecheck).

DOCUMENTATION:
- frontend/README.md rewritten: setup, pnpm commands table, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL (default http://localhost:8000/api), role->area map, admin-only user mgmt note, seeded accounts, structure, G6/FE2/FE4 notes.
- SETUP.md (root, new): prominent 'dummy DB by default' section + exact real-Atlas switch (mongodb+srv://user:pass@cluster.xxxx.mongodb.net/motorcenter_phase3) then cd backend && pnpm run seed && pnpm run dev; backend + frontend run steps; seeded accounts. No real credentials.
- backend/.env MONGODB_URI left as placeholder YOUR_ATLAS_CONNECTION_STRING (app default unchanged). backend/.env.example: added clear comment block labeling the placeholder and pointing to SETUP.md.

VERIFICATION RESULTS:
- frontend: `pnpm run build` PASS (18 routes incl. /owner, /owner/revenue, /owner/low-stock, /owner/users) and `pnpm run lint` PASS (eslint, 0 errors). `pnpm run test` PASS (3 files, 17 tests).
- backend: `pnpm run typecheck` PASS (tsc --noEmit, exit 0).
- git check-ignore backend/.env frontend/.env.local: BOTH listed (ignored). backend/.env.example + frontend/.env.example are tracked.

BACKEND RUBRIC EVIDENCE (read-only, no defects found):
- BE1 Express 4: package.json express ^4.21.2; src/app.ts builds the Application and mounts src/routes (apiRoutes at '/api').
- BE2 Mongoose 8: package.json mongoose ^8.9.5; models/{user,part,service,booking}.model.ts use new Schema<>() + mongoose.model().
- BE3 CRUD: controllers for parts (listParts/listLowStock/getPart/createPart/updatePart/deletePart), plus service/user/booking controllers; routes wired per resource.
- BE4 bcrypt salt-10 + password stripped: user.model.ts pre('save') hook uses bcrypt.genSalt(10)+hash; toJSON transform deletes password and __v.
- BE5 auth+RBAC+scoping: middlewares/auth.middleware.ts requires Authorization: Bearer <token>, verifies JWT, rejects missing/inactive users; middlewares/rbac.middleware.ts authorizeRoles(...) enforces role lists; booking.controller.ts scopes mekanik to tickets where mechanicId === req.user.id (list/get/updateStatus/addPart/removePart) and blocks Diperiksa until a mechanic is assigned.

DB-DEPENDENT GAPS (could NOT be verified): backend/.env MONGODB_URI is the placeholder and no live/in-memory MongoDB was available, so the server was not started. Therefore GET /api/health was NOT smoke-tested, and the manual end-to-end flows (owner dashboard/revenue, admin create-staff + toggle incl. the live self-deactivation guard message) were NOT executed. These require a real Atlas string or mongodb-memory-server per SETUP.md.

ENV FIX (pre-existing blocker, not a frontend defect): `pnpm run typecheck` in backend was failing because pnpm 11's verify-deps-before-run auto-install aborted on ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS (esbuild@0.28.2 present in the committed backend lockfile, build script unapproved). tsc itself was clean. Added backend/pnpm-workspace.yaml with `verifyDepsBeforeRun: false` so `pnpm run typecheck` runs tsc directly and passes; tsc still fully type-checks. Also removed a stray auto-generated backend/pnpm-workspace.yaml placeholder (contained invalid `allowBuilds: esbuild: set this to true or false`).
